items.q: What is OQOOD and why do I need it?
items.a: OQOOD is the pre-registration certificate with the DLD when buying off-plan. It grants legal title until the Title Deed is issued. Without OQOOD the deal is not legally recognised — we file it within the first 30 days.
Yes — this is called assignment. Once 30%+ of the price is paid, you can resell to a new buyer with DLD re-registration. It takes 7–14 days. Ideal for locking profit early.
0% at purchase (the developer pays the fee). 2% of the deal price at resale on handover. No other charges — not for sourcing, not for support, not for paperwork.

items.q: What if the market drops by handover?
items.a: We stress-test every deal at a −15% scenario. We only accept projects with expected appreciation of 50%+ — a 25% margin of safety. In a downside, you exit at breakeven or hold for 12% NET rental yield.
Real cash at launch — from $50K (5% booking + 15% over 12 months). Full property — from $250K. ROIC sweet spot: $500–800K property, $130–200K cash-in.

items.q: How many flip deals can I run in parallel?
items.a: Technically — unlimited, but we recommend no more than 3–4 simultaneously. Each requires capital for quarterly instalments. Family offices with us run 6–10 parallel positions.

items.q: Do I get the investor visa?
items.a: Yes. A property from $205K qualifies for the 2-year Investor Visa, from $545K for the 10-year Golden Visa. The visa activates after OQOOD — i.e. BEFORE handover. Full support included.

items.q: How are payments to the developer protected?
items.a: Every dirham flows through a DLD-controlled escrow. The developer doesn't receive money directly — only when construction milestones are verified. If a project freezes, funds are returned to investors.
